name: Khazarad, Entry Arch
desc1: The city of Khazarad is indeed a wonder to behold. Hollowed out of the
desc2: mountain rock, it is nestled inside a cavern the likes of which has
desc3: never been seen before. The ceiling far above is shrouded in darkness,
desc4: but the walls have been smoothed and carved with intricate, angular
desc5: designs. The streets are paved with tightly-fitted stones, none of
desc6: which are chipped or broken. Three streets head off to the north,
desc7: south and east, while the way out of the city lies to the west.
